name: Velvet Capital
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Users reported abnormal activity on the trading platform of the DeFi asset management protocol Velvet Capital on April 23rd. When attempting to connect to the frontend, users were prompted to approve their wallet's access permissions for the protocol.
